info.title: vvvv-mcp
info.description: MCP server for vvvv gamma — the live .NET visual programming environment. Provides AI agents with node search (6400+ nodes), patch reading and explanation, patch writing (create/add/connect nodes), C# plugin and SDSL shader generation, template access, SQLite FTS5 knowledge search, practical knowledge from help patches and forum solutions, and live bridge to a running vvvv instance.
